UPDATE account_statuses_cleanup_policies
             SET enabled = $2, min_status_age = $3, keep_direct = $4, keep_pinned = $5,
                 keep_polls = $6, keep_media = $7, keep_self_fav = $8,
                 keep_self_bookmark = $9, min_favs = $10, min_reblogs = $11,
                 updated_at = now()
             WHERE account_id = $1
